items.text: Can you pull up the latest pull request review thread for the repo 'acme-dashboard'? I need to see all the comments from the reviewer 'dev_mike' and the suggestions he made about the authentication middleware. Also, check if there are any inline code comments that mention security issues. Once you have that, summarize the key points and tell me if there are any unresolved conversations. I'll need to respond to them before the end of the day.
Did the hackathon organizers send out the schedule for next weekend yet?

I need to check the status of my insurance claim with SafeGuard Insurance. The claim number is SG-98432. Please look for any emails from them in the last two weeks. I want to know if they've requested additional documents or if there's an update on the approval. Also, check if there's any mention of a deadline for submitting paperwork. If you find anything, summarize the key points and let me know what actions I need to take. Thanks!

I'm trying to finalize my pull request for the feature branch 'user-profile-update'. The review from Sarah was mostly positive, but she pointed out a few things: the error handling in the update function needs to be more robust, and the unit tests are missing for the new validation logic. I've addressed those and pushed the changes.

Now I need to reply to her comments and ask her to re-review. Can you draft a response that thanks her for the feedback, mentions that I've fixed the error handling and added the tests, and politely asks if she can take another look when she has time? Also, check if there are any other reviewers who haven't responded yet and remind me to ping them.

On a side note, I saw that the hackathon project I'm mentoring has a team using an AI assistant to help with code reviews—interesting but maybe overkill for a student project. Anyway, focus on the pull request for now.

Hey, can you find the email from the hackathon organizers about the team formation? I think it had a link to a spreadsheet where we need to sign up. Also, check if there's any update on the prize categories. Thanks!

I received an email from the insurance company saying they need more information about my claim. Can you pull up that email and tell me exactly what documents they're asking for? I want to make sure I don't miss anything. Also, check if there's a deadline mentioned. If there is, add a reminder to my calendar for two days before the deadline.

The pull request review for the database migration script is done, and it got approved. Please send a thank-you note to the reviewer, Tom, and mention that I'll merge it after the tests pass. Also, check if there are any other pending pull requests that need my attention. I have a meeting with the team later to discuss the hackathon project, so I need to know if there's anything urgent.

I'm working on my insurance claim for water damage, and I need to submit the receipts for the repairs. Can you find the email from 'QuickFix Plumbing' with the invoice attached? Also, check if there are any other receipts from 'DryClean Experts' for the carpet cleaning. I'll need to forward those to the insurance adjuster. Let me know if you find them.

The hackathon is coming up, and I need to send an email to my team about the schedule. Can you find the email from the organizers with the detailed agenda and forward it to all team members? Also, check if there's any information about the judging criteria. I want to make sure we're prepared. By the way, I heard some teams are using an AI assistant to help with their projects—maybe we should consider that too, but let's discuss later.

I need to review the pull request for the 'payment-gateway' integration. Can you find the email notification from GitHub about the new pull request and show me the diff summary? Also, check if there are any comments from the automated code review tool that might indicate issues. I'll need to address those before merging. Let me know if there's anything critical.
